capabilities: Underline errors Harper misses, such as agreement, tense, wrong-but-real words, and run-ons
Apply or Ignore suggestions from a hover card
Rewrite selected text via command palette or right-click
Skip Harper-flagged issues by querying Harper's plugin
Exclude chosen folders from being sent for checking
disambiguation: Not a standalone proofreader; it only flags what the Harper grammar plugin misses and requires Harper to be installed and enabled.
extras: Desktop-only for now and needs Obsidian 1.11.4+; on Gemini's free tier Google may use sent text to improve its products. Deduplication was verified against a stand-in, not yet against Harper's actual plugin. Source lives in the phoenixak/margin monorepo, which also ships VS Code and browser extensions and a language server.
intentEvidence: An AI second pass for Harper in Obsidian: purple underlines for what Harper's rules can't catch
problem: Harper's rule-based grammar checking cannot catch contextual errors like agreement, tense, wrong-but-real words, and run-ons, so writers need a second pass that complements rule matching.

relations.evidence: Margin asks Harper's own Obsidian plugin what it already flags and skips those
Gemini API: sent to Google with your key
Local model (Ollama / LM Studio): text stays on this device

requires.name: Ollama or LM Studio (for local models)
Gemini API key (for the Gemini provider)

summary: AI second-pass proofreader for the Harper grammar plugin that underlines errors Harper misses and offers Apply, Ignore, and selection rewrites via local models or Gemini.
